d:
之前有些问题，现在尽量修正了。

1.因为每个视频的长宽比不一样，所以之前我想把所有视频都固定在同一个长宽比，导致有的视频被拉伸严重，导致很糊，而且还提高了存储。所以我改成了自动识别长宽度，尽量按原视频比例转化。

2.之前我设置了固定的帧率、分辨率、转化损耗度，但是由于每个视频长度不一、长宽比不一，所以导致按照同样配置转化的视频，有的超出20mb而有的远远没到。所以我改成了先设置最高的转化配置，识别到转化文件在20mb以上时，自动降低一档配置，直到第一个转化文件在20mb以下为止。

3.由于避免太模糊，所以我设置如果转化文件大于20mb，先降低转化损耗度、再是帧率、最后是分辨率。优化之后的文件大概是以FPS=30，Quality=88差不多。

嗯，因为我不是很懂技术，所以我只能做到这么多，如果有更好的建议可以和我说，谢谢。之前上传的我也觉得很糊，抱歉。

There were a few issues before, and I’ve tried my best to fix them.

1.Since every video has a different aspect ratio, I originally tried to force all videos into the same ratio. But that ended up stretching some videos quite badly, making them look blurry and also increasing the file size. So now I’ve changed it to automatically detect the video dimensions and keep the converted video as close to the original aspect ratio as possible.

2.Before, I used the same fixed frame rate, resolution, and quality settings for every video. But since the videos all have different lengths and aspect ratios, some converted files ended up over 20 MB, while others were way below that. Now I start with the highest conversion settings first. If the converted file is over 20 MB, the system automatically lowers the settings step by step until it gets the first version that’s under 20 MB.

3.To avoid making the videos too blurry, if the file is still over 20 MB, I first lower the conversion quality, then the frame rate, and finally the resolution. After the optimization, most videos end up around 30 FPS and Quality 88.

I’m honestly not very technical, so this is about as much as I’ve been able to figure out for now. If you have any better suggestions, please feel free to let me know. Thanks!

I also noticed that some of the videos I uploaded before were pretty blurry, so sorry about that.
